title: Tower made of stone
content: I have had a few dreams of a stone tower that I somehow can fly through the walls of, and I'm flying around the tower fighting someone inside of it sometimes. Cool dreams, but sometimes I get sad because it seems like I'm a ghost in the dream and/or I'm anxious about people knowing I can fly and move through walls. I came across this photo of the Yale Law School and I was like, "that's it!"
